mapper.select: SELECT AIRPORT_ID, IATA_CODE, AIRPORT_NAME FROM AIRPORT WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY AIRPORT_NAME ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT F.FLIGHT_ID, F.FLIGHT_NO, F.FLIGHT_STATUS AS STATUS, F.FLIGHT_STATUS AS STATUS_TEXT, F.DELAY_MINUTES, DG.GATE_CODE AS DEP_GATE, AG.GATE_CODE AS ARR_GATE, TO_CHAR(F.DEPARTURE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF1') AS DEP_DATETIME, TO_CHAR(F.ARRIVAL_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF1') AS ARR_DATETIME, TO_CHAR(F.DEPARTURE_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS DEP_TIME, TO_CHAR(F.ARRIVAL_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS ARR_TIME, DA.IATA_CODE AS DEP_IATA, DA.AIRPORT_NAME AS DEP_NAME, AA.IATA_CODE AS ARR_IATA, AA.AIRPORT_NAME AS ARR_NAME FROM FLIGHT F INNER JOIN ROUTE R ON F.ROUTE_ID = R.ROUTE_ID INNER JOIN AIRPORT DA ON R.DEPARTURE_AIRPORT_ID = DA.AIRPORT_ID INNER JOIN AIRPORT AA ON R.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_ID = AA.AIRPORT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN GATE DG ON F.DEPARTURE_GATE_ID = DG.GATE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN GATE AG ON F.ARRIVAL_GATE_ID = AG.GATE_ID WHERE F.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND F.DEPARTURE_TIME >= SYSDATE ORDER BY F.DEPARTURE_TIME ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
